case_title: CHRIS HECTOR VS. TONY K. LEE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,424.88 FILED BY HECTOR, CHRIS AS TO DEFENDANT LEE, TONY K. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-30-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
REQUEST TO POSTPONE SMALL CLAIMS HEARING (REQUEST FORWARDED TO DEPT 506 FOR JUDICIAL REVIEW & SIGNATURE.) FILED BY DEFENDANT LEE, TONY K.
ORDER ON REQUEST TO POSTPONE THE SMALL CLAIMS HEARING. THE REQUEST IS GRANTED.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-30-2022 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO OCT-25-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506
STIPULATION TO USE JUDGE PRO TEM OR HEARING OFFICER. FILED BY HECTOR, CHRIS LEE, TONY K.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-25-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-25-2022 BY JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE. PLAINTIFF CHRIS HECTOR IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT TONY K LEE IS PRESENT AND WITH AMY LEE, DAUGHTER STATED SHE IS AUTHORIZED TO SPEAK ON BEHALF OF TONY K LEE (SEE SCANNED SC-109). NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) AMY LEE, DAUGHTER. FILED BY DEFENDANT LEE, TONY K.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-25-2022 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HECTOR, CHRIS IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT LEE, TONY K. UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES PRESENTED THE COURT FINDS THAT DEFENDANT ACTED REASONBLY BY RETURNING THE SECURITY DEPOSIT, WITH MINOR DEDUCTION FOR DAMAGE, TO PLAINTIFF AND HIS CO-TENANTS IN THE MANNER SHE DID, AND THAT IT WAS NOT UP TO DEFENDANT TO SORT OUT RELATIVE DEBTS AMONG THE CO-TENANTS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
